summary: Decode assistant principals as read-side timeline reply recipients

replay.detail: No claim replay, historical-invalid reclassification or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No stored schema changes. The client v0 wire schema adds TimelineRecipientRef for TimelineMessageBody.to, representing agent, assistant, person and step references on timeline reads.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, signature checks or replicated admission rules change.

compatibility.detail: Regenerated TypeScript decoders accept assistant/chatgpt as the recipient of a native agent reply in a session timeline. The message.send recipient wire schema remains Id; current grant scope and recipient_allowlist authorization remain unchanged. ParticipantRef signers and ActorRef actors are unchanged. Rust and Swift retain string recipient fields.

downtime.detail: No additional startup work or interruption.

manual.detail: Update servers (daemons) before clients. Until updated, older TypeScript clients using the generated rich schema fail to decode timeline entries addressed to assistant/<id> in both strict and tolerant modes; they do not decode these as unknown recipients. Rust and Swift string recipient fields continue to decode. No re-pairing is required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state or rollback changes. This read-side change does not re-admit records previously classified invalid.
